title: release: automation for artifact signing, provenance, and release manifests for private installer
author: Maya Chen
description: This PR adds automation to build, sign, and generate provenance/release-manifests for the redwood-private-installer artifacts used in VPC/on-prem deployments. Motivation: customers and internal compliance require verifiable artifact provenance (SLSA-style attestations), reproducible release manifests for air-gapped installs, and cryptographic signing for binary/helm/image releases. The change set includes: 1) GitHub Actions workflows to build artifacts, generate SBOMs, produce in-toto/COSIGN attestations, and upload signed artifacts to the release bucket; 2) a `scripts/generate-release-manifest.py` utility that collates artifact metadata (shasum, cosign sig, sbom link, build-id) into a single release-manifest.yaml used by the private installer; 3) `scripts/sign_artifacts.sh` which wraps cosign/GPG signing and supports optional KMS-backed keys; 4) Helm chart and terraform module updates so the installer can resolve release-manifests and verify signatures at install/upgrade time; 5) lightweight integration tests (terratest + helm) to validate signature checks in CI. Checklist: - [x] Add GHA workflows: build-artifacts.yml, sign-and-provenance.yml - [x] Implement release-manifest generator and doc updates - [x] Add cosign-based signature verification in installer helm hooks - [x] Add tests and CI gating for signed-release promotion - [x] Update release playbook and roll-forward instructions Notes: The workflows support two signing modes: local GPG (dev/test) and KMS/cosign (recommended for prod). The manifest format is intentionally minimal to support air-gapped installs: artifact path, sha256, signature-url, sbom-url, builder-id, build-timestamp, and attestation-url. See docs/release-provenance.md for format details and command examples. Related Linear tasks: ENG-3456 (release automation) and ENG-3492 (installer signature verification).

changed_files: .github/workflows/build-artifacts.yml -- New workflow that builds installer tarballs, container images, and SBOMs. (uses sbom-generator v0.3 and buildkit).

.github/workflows/sign-and-provenance.yml -- New workflow that runs cosign, produces attestation (in-toto format), signs artifacts and uploads to release-bucket (GCS/S3). Includes conditional path for KMS-backed key via COSIGN_KMS_URI.

scripts/generate-release-manifest.py -- New utility that reads build metadata and produces release-manifest.yaml. Example output fields: artifact, sha256, signature_url, sbom_url, builder_id, build_ts, attestation_url.
scripts/sign_artifacts.sh -- New helper for local/dev signing (gpg) and cosign-based signing; supports env vars: COSIGN_PASSWORD, COSIGN_KMS_URI, GPG_KEY. Includes verification helpers.
charts/redwood-private-installer/values.yaml -- Added 'releaseManifestUrl' and 'verifySignatures' flags and defaults to true for release builds.
charts/redwood-private-installer/templates/hooks/verify-signature-job.yaml -- Helm hook which downloads manifest and runs a verify step before install/upgrade (bash verification using cosign).
terraform/modules/installer/README.md -- Documented release-manifest configuration and how to point to signed manifests in air-gapped workflows.
docs/release-provenance.md -- New doc describing manifest schema, signing modes, verification steps, and playbook for rotation/revocation.
Makefile -- add 'release-manifest' target and 'sign' helpers for local dev flow.
test/terratest/signed_manifest_test.go -- Integration test that runs installer in a k3s cluster and asserts signature verification passes/fails as expected.
pkg/installer/manifest_verifier.go -- New verifier (lightweight shell wrapper integration) used by helm hook. Note: implementation delegates to cosign via exec for now.
README.md -- update release section with 'Signing and provenance' steps and links to docs/release-provenance.md.
scripts/ci-helpers/check-signature.sh -- small helper used in CI to assert the uploaded signatures match shasum.
review_comments: Luis Ortega (reviewer): Please ensure KMS key rotation is documented and that the workflows don't leak key material in logs. Also consider adding an allowlist for accepted cosign key IDs in the installer.

Maya Chen (author reply): Added KMS rotation section to docs/release-provenance.md and masked COSIGN_KMS_URI logs in the GHA workflow. Added an optional 'acceptedCosignKeyIDs' list to values.yaml (see commit b1c2d3e).
Anika Patel (reviewer): Can we gate helm hook verification behind a feature flag to avoid breaking existing airgap upgrades?

Maya Chen (author reply): Helm flag 'verifySignatures' defaults to true for release pipelines but can be disabled in values for controlled upgrades. Documented upgrade flow and rollback if verification fails.
Diego Ramos (reviewer, security): Add an integration test that validates failure cases (tampered artifact) and ensure pipeline fails fast on mismatches.

Maya Chen (author reply): Added terratest that intentionally corrupts a tarball and asserts verification fails (see test/terratest/signed_manifest_test.go). CI now blocks promotion if signature verification fails.

release_notes: Add automated build+sign+provenance workflows for private-installer; generate machine-readable release-manifests and helm verification hooks. Enables verifiable air-gapped installs and compliant release promotion.
notes: This PR contains changes that affect release pipelines. Release engineers should follow docs/release-provenance.md to configure COSIGN_KMS_URI and acceptedCosignKeyIDs before promoting artifacts to production buckets. Rolling back is supported by using previous release-manifest.yaml and setting verifySignatures=false temporarily.
